svg.title: Repository Engineering Snapshot
svg.desc: Dashboard: 9,546 tracked files, 858 directories, 4,253 commits on 127 unique days; file counts by type, strict_types 1,621 of 1,621, code signals, and a daily commit sparkline.
svg.text: Tracked repository facts from the latest audit
Bars compare raw counts. Categories overlap (tests are also PHP), so they do not sum to a whole.
One bar per calendar day. Gaps are days without commits. Activity signal only, not a quality measure.
Point-in-time counts from the tracked repository audit. Not every metric is comparable with another.
